summary: Backend tested end-to-end against public URL (https://miguel-barber.preview.emergentagent.com/api). 21/22 tests passed (95.5%). Seed data (5 services w/ correct prices+durations, 4 featured zones, 10 FAQs w/ 2 pending_confirmation, 11 policies), site/booking settings defaults, empty testimonials, available-slots on Sundays and closed on Mondays, all booking validations (policies=false→400, ends-after-close→400, non-open-day→400, conflict→409, happy path→200), admin auth (login OK, wrong pwd→401, /admin/me with/without token, /admin/bookings auth), admin booking-settings + site-settings updates all work and MongoDB _id never leaks in any response. One CRITICAL bug: POST /api/admin/services returns HTTP 500 due to Python TypeError 'got multiple values for keyword argument slug' at server.py:468.

critical.issue: Returns 500. Root cause: server.py line 468 does `Service(**payload.model_dump(), slug=payload.slug or _slugify(payload.name))`. Since ServiceInput already contains a `slug` field (Optional[str]=None), `model_dump()` puts `slug` in the kwargs dict AND you also pass `slug=` explicitly → TypeError: 'Service' got multiple values for keyword argument 'slug'. Fix: pop/replace slug first, e.g. `data = payload.model_dump(); data['slug'] = payload.slug or _slugify(payload.name); svc = Service(**data)`. Admin create-service is completely broken until this is fixed.

minor.issue: There is no admin endpoint to delete/cancel bookings, so TEST bookings created during testing remain in the DB (name='TEST_User' on the next Sunday). Consider exposing DELETE /api/admin/bookings/{id} for cleanup, or manually remove the TEST_User booking(s).

passlib warning at startup: 'trapped error reading bcrypt version — module bcrypt has no attribute __about__'. Non-fatal (bcrypt still works, login succeeds), but noisy. Pin passlib>=1.7.5 with bcrypt<4 OR upgrade to a passlib version compatible with newer bcrypt.

action_items: Fix POST /api/admin/services (server.py:468) — remove the duplicate `slug` kwarg. Suggested: `data = payload.model_dump(); data['slug'] = payload.slug or _slugify(payload.name); svc = Service(**data); await db.services.insert_one(svc.model_dump())`.
Clean up TEST_User booking(s) created on the next Sunday (or add an admin cancel/delete-booking endpoint used by tests).
Optional: silence passlib/bcrypt version warning by aligning versions in backend/requirements.txt.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:468 duplicate-kwarg TypeError (as above) — same pattern is safe elsewhere because other admin routes don't override a field already present in the Input model.
available-slots and create-booking treat local time as UTC-6 without DST handling — fine for Torreón/CST (no DST since 2022), but should be documented.
No pagination on admin/bookings — `.to_list(500)` will silently cap at 500 rows once bookings grow. Acceptable for MVP.

seed() runs on every startup and is idempotent by count; good. However site_settings and booking_settings are only created if the collection is empty — updates to defaults in code won't propagate to existing DBs. Acceptable but worth a comment.
seed_data_creation: Test created 1 booking on the next Sunday with name='TEST_User', phone='8711111111', neighborhood='Viñedos' (used for the happy-path booking + conflict test + admin/bookings persistence check). It remains in the DB because there is no admin delete-booking endpoint. All CRUD tests for services/booking-settings/site-settings restore state (deleted after create, open_days reset to [0], slogan reverted).

rca_of_issue: Bug: POST /api/admin/services → 500. Reproduction: `curl -X POST $BASE/api/admin/services -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"X","price":100,"duration_minutes":30}'`. Traceback: TypeError: Service() got multiple values for keyword argument 'slug' at server.py:468. Root cause: `ServiceInput` declares `slug: Optional[str] = None`, so `payload.model_dump()` contains the key `slug`; expanding with `**` and then passing `slug=` again causes the collision. Mitigation shown in action_items.
